verdict.rationale: Productboard explicitly claims a single searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers. The API docs back this up with feedback search, filters (owner, tags, date, status) and customer attribution, and integrations route feedback in from sales/support conversations, messaging tools, CRMs and internal tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs for in-app (UI) search beyond the marketing claim and the API search endpoints.
